name: cp1-pfom-v1
input: Binary GT and cached >=0.5 prediction, float64 0/1 for Canny, full 224x224 canvas
distance: Nearest GT edge for each predicted edge; Euclidean pixels; asymmetric prediction-to-GT
normalization: max(number of GT edges, number of predicted edges), separately per image
aggregation: Arithmetic mean over images; also report median, both-edge-nonempty subset, and categories
explicit_analysis_choices: scikit-image 0.19.3 Canny implementation; thresholds 0.1/0.2, float64 input, and border defaults made explicit
Bounded extension: both edge maps empty => 1, exactly one empty => 0
Sentinel-2 proxy interprets 'no edge in any of the images' as either edge map being empty
comparability: Authors did not publish PFOM code or all Canny settings. Sentinel behavior is ambiguous and not implied by Equation 13. These results are a documented implementation, not verified numerical reproduction of Figure 6.
